chunks: And from him (Al-Shaykh) from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-'Ala' who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who places his hands before his knees in the prayer, and he said, 'Yes.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to place hands before knees when bowing in prayer?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms the permissibility of placing hands on the chest or back before touching the knees during ruku', reflecting the scholarly discussion on the precise mechanics of bowing. This ruling highlights the flexibility in the physical execution of prayer postures within Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing between essential pillars and recommended etiquettes. The confirmation underscores the importance of humility and proper form as emphasized in prophetic tradition.
